explanation: Choose every possible left-subtree node count and combine every left and right shape. Memoize these immutable shape sets. Serialize each root breadth-first, emitting 1 for nodes and 0 for all null child positions; the null root therefore becomes [0].
spaceComplexity: O(n·Cₙ), including output; auxiliary memo stores O(Cₙ) shapes
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
